heroTitle: Check if something online is real — in 3 easy steps.
step1Title: What do you want to check?

tabHelp.text: Paste a news statement, viral WhatsApp message, or social media claim.
tabHelp.image: Upload a photo or screenshot to check format, camera tags, and editing watermarks.
tabHelp.video: Upload a video file to verify format, stream validity, and deepfake signals.
tabHelp.audio: Upload an audio recording to check speech cadence and voice clone signals.
tabHelp.url: Enter a link to check HTTPS security, known publisher status, and lookalike risks.

placeholders.text: Paste claim text here (up to 5,000 characters)...

dropzones.photo: Drop your photo here or click to choose
dropzones.video: Drop your video here or click to choose
dropzones.audio: Drop your audio file here or click to choose

verdictHeadlines.scoreNull: We can't tell from the file alone

confidenceLevels.tooltip: This shows how strong our evidence is, not whether the content is true.

sourcesEmpty.notChecked: Fact-check search is turned off in this version (no Google Fact Check API key configured).
sourcesEmpty.noMatches: We did not find any published fact-checks for this claim. That does not mean it is true.

disclaimer: Satya Lens gives signals, not final proof. Always check with trusted sources.
privacyNote: We do not store what you check. Files are held in memory during analysis and never saved to disk.

footer.title: Satya Lens • See what's real.
footer.tagline: An open educational tool providing signals to help you judge content reliability. Never a substitute for critical thinking.
